requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

390-1486-4231-5929--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Hulking Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

5686-7084-8293.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

792-4279-4616--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-4616--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4770-5295-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

628-6495-7200.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Reluctant Dounguard.
When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7200.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2738-3967-4871-4976.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Open the Graves, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2111-5256-6792.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

620-1429-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1170-1636-4113-7417.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Wild Idea using convoke without paying mana.
1170-1636-4113-7417.description:
Cast Wild Idea using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sanar, Unfinished Genius.
When Sanar, Unfinished Genius enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

4644-7221-7791.notablePrerequisites: There's an Elf card in your graveyard.
4644-7221-7791.description:
Activate Lys Alana Dignitary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Lys Alana Dignitary.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Lys Alana Dignitary.
Repeat.

1115-4289-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1115-4289-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1115-4289-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2510-3532-5078-7719.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3532-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1368-2033-3480-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-3480-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

283-5189-5641.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, targeting Basking Broodscale.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Ghave's ability, targeting Basking Broodscale.
Resolve the first Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 for the other Ghave ability.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

147-2438-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2438-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

240-4885-5470-6798.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

465-3742-4251-4452-7296.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2440-3263-4183-7220.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
2440-3263-4183-7220.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Glamermite with haste.
When the token Glamermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Glamermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Glamermite.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5226-6972-7154.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

2034-3875-6664-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

45-1183-4853.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Khalni Gem.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

671-3490-4017-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-3490-4017-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

549-1978-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
549-1978-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat from step 2.

2866-3518-3698-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrap Trawler and Lion's Eye Diamond enter, Grinding Station triggers twice, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

1003-2173-2511-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2292-4186-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
2292-4186-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
2292-4186-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.

3815-4067-5042.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four other artifacts.
You control a mana-producing permanent that can produce at least {U}.
3815-4067-5042.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Tamiyo's Logbook by paying {U} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping Tamiyo's Logbook and the mana producing permanent.
Repeat.

1558-1977-4365.notablePrerequisites:
Tivit does not have summoning sickness.
Tivit cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1558-1977-4365.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Tivit.
Tivit triggers, creating at least six artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3099-3995-4289.notablePrerequisites: Horseshow Crab does not have summoning sickness.
3099-3995-4289.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab's ability from Cryptolith Rites by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance's second ability triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab's own ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance's last ability any number of times.

884-2232-3260-4740.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least ten.
You have a creature card in hand with mana cost {B}.
884-2232-3260-4740.description:
Cast any creature card in your hand with mana cost {B} by paying 2 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir and K'rrik trigger.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Ayara and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ayara from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Ayara by paying 6 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir and K'rrik trigger.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ayara enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the creature with mana cost {B} from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large lifetotal, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir's ability infinite times to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
